plugin.name: Tencent Meeting
plugin.description: Connect Tencent Meeting to sync meetings and recordings on demand, view transcripts and smart minutes, archive to projects, and generate meeting minutes and action items. Requires the official tmeet CLI and account authorization.
tool.tencent_meeting_action.description: Tencent Meeting plugin: check connection, authorize login, sync on demand, view meetings and transcripts, and archive project files.
